data.report: November 22, 2026 | 7:14 AM Yesterday delivered powdery turns, top-to-bottom skiing and riding, and terrain open from base to base. The season is off to a strong start. 10 lifts are scheduled to operate from 9 AM–4 PM, with Summit Express and Siberia added to today’s schedule. Summit Express is expected to have a delayed opening, and terrain will continue to expand as conditions allow. One terrain park is also open off Belmont. Today’s Outlook: Mostly cloudy, with a high near 29°F, southwest winds around 5 mph, and a 40% chance of snow. Safety Reminder: Early season conditions exist. Respect rope boundaries and signage, and watch for marked and unmarked hazards including low snow, hidden obstacles, and open creeks. See you out there! -Dom For real-time information at your fingertips, download the Ikon Pass App for updates on lift status, events, weather, and more.
